title: wemerang
tagline: Wemerang is a marketplace to connect brands with everyday heroes, to help the planet, people and animals.
description: Everyday heroes lead their own actions to solve social and environmental problems. Wemerang is the marketplace to connect them with brands and celebrities that what to capture reputation and brand equity, through sponsorhips that allow these everyday heroes to get access to the resources they need to make more a greater impact for the causes they care about.
how_its_made: Wemerang has an web2 MVP that has proven that brands want to sponsor challenges to capture reputation and brand equity. We are on a stage where we want to migrate to web3 to increase impact, flexibility and accountability on empowering everyday heroes. For this hackathon, we built our prototype on Figma for UI purposes to give an idea of the potential in this business on the web3 ecosystem. A lot of the functionalities that we are showing on this UI prototype can be solved over the Lens Protocol capabilities, and that's why we want to build on top of this technology and the web3 community.
